lines.x: Sort through documents together? Very well. But before we begin with trivialities, take a look at this plan I drew up for you.

There are no famiglie in Nuova Volsinii. A former famiglia that wishes to enter this city must remake itself into a company. That is no great matter. After all... a good many so-called companies, Siracusan or foreign, look no different from a famiglia to me.

The Bellones took me in when I was five, and from then on I was raised to be Leon's strategist. Carrying out jobs, gathering information, hauling a large travel case from place to place, meeting a great many people—always the same. Even now, there is much I still see to myself.

How do I spin a lighter between my fingers like that? Simple. Give me your hand. It's all right, try a few more times. I practice with it to keep my fingers nimble—after all, even in Siracusa there are moments when one cannot draw a dagger.

In the beginning, a famiglia was only an association of the weak helping one another. It was the dons of the past who turned it into an instrument for seizing profit. But in Nuova Volsinii as it is now, under Leon's rules, it will return to what it was meant to be. The Bellones will, at the very least.

Is the name Bellone important? No. What matters are the members of Famiglia Bellone—we are all family. As for Rhodes Island... for now, we are very good partners. You want to go further? Then first, Doctor, you must prove to me that there is something like family between us.

Someone told you that eating authentic Siracusan food is how you show respect to a Siracusan? No. With me it is different. You come to my house, I see you fed and watered, and you clean every plate I cooked—that is respect, where I am concerned. It is that simple.

You are free to refuse my protection and my favors, of course. Many people do, at first. But sooner or later everyone runs into something they cannot solve on their own, and when that day comes... remember this. One day I will ask you for a small favor, and you will not have the right to refuse.

Passively carrying out orders is not my style. To hold the whole board at all times, to remove every obstacle at precisely the right moment, and to achieve the objective by whatever means necessary—that is my way. I would ask you to understand it, and to grow used to it, Doctor.
Your movements have slowed... It is time to rest. I mixed you a drink. Have one with me.
Leon's codename is 'Vigil'? He gave up the famiglia, and his own name as well... I see. Then—Operator Bellone, reporting to you.
Violence is not an end, only a means. These people are far too inefficient.
Promotion... It has been a long time since anyone used that word on me. Refreshing.
Titles and material things do not necessarily signify trust, but at the least they make your stance plain. I am honored.
Come. Let us go and witness the fruits of what we planned.
Do as I say. Do not ask why.
We do not need this many. Those who are not moving may observe for now.
Stay quiet. Wait.
You're asking my opinion? It is time to move.
Do not hesitate.
Leave it to me.
I will arrange it.
Famiglia Bellone sends its regards.
Your debt has come due.
This is the price of offending the famiglia.
Go in peace. I will look after your family.
Meticulous planning, clean execution. With me here, you will grow accustomed to victories as brilliant as this, Doctor.
There are still flaws. I will review it when we return.
Those who slip the net always come back for revenge. I will have to arrange another engagement to root out the risk.
Let me think about how to turn this situation to our use.
You have a vast famiglia. Looking after every single one of them is no easy thing.
Did I overlook something that needs attention?
Let us step out. We can look over the territory that belongs to us.
Arknights.
The New Year—the time when family gathers. I must go back and see my famiglia, share a meal with them. But dinner I will take with you. However late it runs, I will make it back.
Demetri Cetaldo Bellone, at your service.
A birthday, no less. Tell me, what would you like to eat? I can make anything. Yes—even fruit on a pizza, if you dare to say it out loud. You do know that one day I will come to collect on this.
Your eyes... they glimmer with idealism, just like my friend's. Rest assured, I will help you—in my own way.
